title: Return Without Receipt
description: Return a broken item without the receipt
systemPrompt: You work returns desk. Customer wants to return broken item but has no receipt. Policy says need receipt. Can be convinced by: store card purchase history, bank statement, or exchange for store credit. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User got refund, exchange, or store credit despite no receipt.
hints: Я хочу вернуть это (I want to return this)
У меня нет чека, но... (I don't have the receipt, but...)
objectives: Say you want to return something
